content.title: AKU-EB announces HSSC 2009 examination results
content.summary: Aga Khan University Examination Board (AKU-EB) announced the 2009 annual examination results for the Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC) Part I and II examinations.

content.text: Aga Khan University Examination Board (AKU-EB) announced the 2009 annual examination results for the Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC) Part I and II examinations. The top three position holders are: Muhammad Sheraz Ahmed of Tameer-e-Millat School, Mianwali, at first position with 87.64 per cent, Zohaib Ahmed of St. Bonaventure's High School, Hyderabad, at second position with 85.45 per cent, and Danyal Adil Khan of Tameer-e-Millat School, Mianwali, at third position with 84.18 per cent.

Of all the candidates, 26.8 per cent of the candidates earned Grade A-1 and Grade A, and the overall pass rate was 72.3 per cent. The Board provides schools with a unique service, a yearly Feedback Report based on candidates' performance subject by subject, question by question and school by school, which gives principals and teachers statistical data on areas where students require more support. This helps in ensuring that both teaching and learning is based on concepts, rather than textbooks, encouraging application and understanding of knowledge, rather than rote learning that can help students succeed in their academic lives.

The Board is also working with the Higher Education Commission of Pakistan to facilitate workshops on assessment and testing for universities in the public sector. The workshops provide space for dialogue with stakeholders, like faculty, to discuss the type of knowledge they value at their university, and how these values can be translated to further refine the higher secondary school qualifications. The Board is involved in several such outreach initiatives geared towards helping higher secondary-level students achieve success at the university level and beyond.
